## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 11, 2026 - Oct 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ekei Otto_, Oct 31, 2026, 2/5: "This app is so unbelievably glitchy. I can't even add/edit/delete tasks on the to do list. The page and the keyboard keep jumping around and popping up. Can't even see the whole page or scroll. I won't even do the free trial at this point because I can't get the app to work at first open."
            2. _Fj Smith_, Oct 1, 2026, 3/5: "Update: contacting support team has never fixed any of the same ongoing issues. Why does it still decide to turn off notifications for a task I consistently custom snooze to have it at varying times I want it? It's better for me than using repeat task but from eco, that fails too. It's been doing this for years and there's no fix that works, it basically does this after every several notifications for each task. Otherwise good app."
            3. _Prashant Vatkar_, Oct 16, 2026, 4/5: "Any.do Notifications & Reminders are not working on my Realme GT 7T Phone since I logged in this New Mobile. Reminders are still working on my old Android Phone, but not on Realme GT 7T. I have checked all the Notifications settings of GT 7T, everything is enabled. My Phone running on Realme UI 7 with Android 16 up to date. Kindly resolve the issue ASAP."
